key_insight: AutoScaffold turns reinforcement-learning experience into adaptive training guidance that improves language-model performance even after the guidance is removed.
engineering_relevance: A frozen teacher automates training-support design across reasoning and engineering tasks, reducing reliance on manually crafted, domain-specific scaffolds.
method: Periodically inspect student training experience to diagnose learning bottlenecks.
Generate shared task-class strategies and hints for individual hard tasks.
Adapt support as the student improves, then remove all scaffolds at evaluation.
evidence_signal: Across four domains, scaffold-free evaluation outperformed corresponding RL baselines; in math, the student surpassed QuestA’s reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps.
watch_item: Fewer student training steps do not establish lower total compute cost; teacher inference and scaffold-generation overhead also need accounting.
paper_title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
